To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of TS-fuzzy predictor observer for tracking error model based PDC controller is an effective approach to control the tracking of wheeled non-holonomic mobile robots.
we propose a new method to solve the trajectory tracking problem for wheeled mobile robot using a fuzzy predictor observer.

1) the proposed approach is suitable to solve the problem of trajectory tracking of non-holonomic mobile robot, 2) the TS fuzzy predictor observer is more robust than the nonlinear predictor observer and 3) it is possible to use the TS fuzzy approach to solve the tracking problem of a non-holonomic wheeled mobile robot.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel control strategy for a wheeled mobile robot that is able to track a given reference trajectory.
the design of a new technique for the control of non-holonomic wheeled mobile robot with delay in the outputs and the stability analysis of the closed-loop systems.
the development of a control scheme based on TS-fuzzy predictor observer to solve the problem of the tracking of a nonholonomic mobile robot in the presence of a constant delay in the outputs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is more efficient in terms of tracking error than other approaches.
the use of TS fuzzy predictor observers in PDC control of non-holonomic systems is a good alternative to the nonlinear predictor observer.
the proposed approach has a great potential to be implemented in real time.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an observer-based controller for a non-holonomic mobile robot.
we propose a new technique for the tracking-error TS fuzzy model based PDC control of wheeled mobile robots with delay.
we have proposed a new technique for the design of PDC control for mobile robot tracking problem with delay in the measurements.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed method is able to track the reference trajectory with a good accuracy.
the TS fuzzy observer is a good candidate to compensate the delay in the output and the tracking error of the mobile robot is reduced.
we can use a TS fuzzy predictor-observer to design a PDC controller for non-holonomy wheeled mobile robots.
